items.source: There is a Class Hierarchy page for all packages, plus a hierarchy for each package. Each hierarchy page contains a list of classes and a list of interfaces. Classes are organized by inheritance structure starting with java.lang.Object. Interfaces do not inherit from java.lang.Object.
items.translation: 所有包都有一个类层次结构页面，每个包也有一个层次结构。每个层次结构页面包含一个类列表和一个接口列表。类按继承结构组织，从java.lang.Object开始。接口不从java.lang.Object继承。

items.source: The Index contains an alphabetic index of all classes, interfaces, constructors, methods, and fields in the documentation, as well as summary pages such as All Packages, All Classes and Interfaces.
items.translation: 索引包含文档中所有类、接口、构造函数、方法和字段的字母顺序索引，以及“所有包”、“所有类和接口”等摘要页面。

items.source: Refer to the Javadoc Search Specification for a full description of search features.
items.translation: 有关搜索功能的完整描述，请参阅Javadoc 搜索规范。

items.source: The Overview page is the front page of this API document and provides a list of all packages with a summary for each. This page can also contain an overall description of the set of packages.
items.translation: "概述"页面是本 API 文档的首页，列出了所有包及其摘要。该页面还可以包含对包集合的整体描述。

items.source: Note: Annotation interfaces have required and optional elements, but not methods. Only enum classes have enum constants. The components of a record class are displayed as part of the declaration of the record class. Properties are a feature of JavaFX.
items.translation: 注意： 注解接口包含必需和可选元素，但不包含方法。只有枚举类才具有枚举常量。记录类的组件作为记录类声明的一部分显示。属性是 JavaFX 的一项功能。

items.source: The Constant Field Values page lists the static final fields and their values.
items.translation: Constant Field Values 页面列出了静态最终字段及其值。

items.source: The All Packages page contains an alphabetic index of all packages contained in the documentation.
items.translation: "All Packages" 页面包含文档中所有包的字母顺序索引。

items.source: The All Classes and Interfaces page contains an alphabetic index of all classes and interfaces contained in the documentation, including annotation interfaces, enum classes, and record classes.
items.translation: "All Classes and Interfaces" 页面包含文档中所有类和接口的字母顺序索引，包括注解接口、枚举类和记录类。

items.source: You can search for definitions of modules, packages, types, fields, methods, system properties and other terms defined in the API. These items can be searched using part or all of the name, optionally using "camelCase" abbreviations, or multiple search terms separated by whitespace. Some examples:
items.translation: 您可以搜索 API 中定义的模块、包、类型、字段、方法、系统属性和其他术语的定义。这些项目可以使用名称的一部分或全部进行搜索，可选地使用"camelCase"缩写，或使用由空格分隔的多个搜索词。一些示例：

items.source: Documentation pages provide keyboard shortcuts to facilitate access to common navigation tasks.
items.translation: 文档页面提供键盘快捷键，以方便访问常见的导航任务。

items.source: Each package has a page that contains a list of its classes and interfaces, with a summary for each. These pages may contain the following categories:
items.translation: 每个包都有一个页面，其中包含其类和接口的列表，并为每个类或接口提供摘要。这些页面可能包含以下类别：

items.source: Each class, interface, nested class and nested interface has its own separate page. Each of these pages has three sections consisting of a declaration and description, member summary tables, and detailed member descriptions. Entries in each of these sections are omitted if they are empty or not applicable.
items.translation: 每个类、接口、内部类和内部接口都有各自独立的页面。这些页面中的每一页都包含三个部分：声明和描述、成员摘要表以及详细的成员描述。如果某个部分为空或不适用，则该部分中的条目将被省略。

items.source: The summary entries are alphabetical, while the detailed descriptions are in the order they appear in the source code. This preserves the logical groupings established by the programmer.
items.translation: 摘要条目按字母顺序排列，而详细描述则按照其在源代码中出现的顺序排列。这保留了程序员建立的逻辑分组。

items.source: Packages and modules may contain pages with additional information related to the declarations nearby.
items.translation: 包和模块可能包含与附近声明相关的附加信息页面。

items.source: Each documented package, class or interface has its own Use page, which lists packages, classes, interfaces, methods, constructors and fields that use any part of that package, class or interface. Given a class or interface A, its Use page includes subclasses or subinterfaces of A, fields declared as A, methods that return A, methods and constructors with parameters of type A, and subclasses or subinterfaces with parameters of type A. You can access this page by first going to the package, class or interface, then clicking on the USE link in the navigation bar.
items.translation: 每个已记录的包、类或接口都有自己的 Use 页面，该页面列出了使用包、类或接口的任何部分的包、类、接口、方法、构造函数和字段。给定一个类或接口 A，其 Use 页面包括 A 的子类或子接口、声明为 A 的字段、返回类型为 A 的方法、参数类型为 A 的方法和构造函数，以及参数类型为 A 的子类或子接口。您可以通过首先访问包、类或接口，然后单击导航栏中的 USE 链接来访问此页面。

items.source: Each serializable or externalizable class has a description of its serialization fields and methods. This information is of interest to those who implement rather than use the API. While there is no link in the navigation bar, you can get to this information by going to any serialized class and clicking "Serialized Form" in the "See Also" section of the class description.
items.translation: 每个可序列化或外部化类都包含其序列化字段和方法的描述。这些信息对实现 API 的人员更有意义，而非使用 API 的人员。虽然导航栏中没有链接，但您可以进入任何已序列化的类，并在该类描述的“另请参阅”部分中点击“序列化形式”来获取此信息。

items.source: The details for each module, package, class or interface normally include the release in which the declaration was introduced.
items.translation: 每个模块、包、类或接口的详细信息通常包括引入该声明的发布版本。

items.source: When a member is added after the initial introduction of the enclosing class or interface, the details of the member include the release in which it was introduced.
items.translation: 当成员在包含类或接口的初始引入之后添加时，该成员的详细信息包括其被引入的发布版本。

items.source:
Type 
<kbd>Tab</kbd>
/
<kbd>↓</kbd>
/
<kbd>↑</kbd>
 to select list items after entering a search term in a search or filter input field.
items.translation: 在搜索或筛选输入字段中输入搜索术语后，按 <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>↓</kbd> / <kbd>↑</kbd> 来选择列表项。

items.source:
Type 
<kbd>←</kbd>
/
<kbd>→</kbd>
 to switch between tabs in tabbed summary tables.
items.translation: 按 <kbd>←</kbd> / <kbd>→</kbd> 在选项卡式摘要表之间切换。

items.source:
Type 
<kbd>/</kbd>
 to access the search input field in any page.
items.translation: 输入 <kbd>/</kbd> 可在任何页面中访问搜索输入字段。

items.source:
Type 
<kbd>.</kbd>
 to access the filter input field in the sidebar of class  pages.
items.translation: 输入 <kbd>.</kbd> 以访问类页面的侧边栏中的过滤器输入字段。

items.source:
Type 
<kbd>Esc</kbd>
 to clear the input and release keyboard focus in any input field.
items.translation: 按 <kbd>Esc</kbd> 键可清除输入并释放任何输入字段中的键盘焦点。

items.source: When viewing the Overview page, clicking on TREE displays the hierarchy for all packages.
items.translation: 查看概览页面时，点击 TREE 可显示所有包的层次结构。

items.source: When viewing a particular package, class or interface page, clicking on TREE displays the hierarchy for only that package.
items.translation: 查看特定的包、类或接口页面时，点击 TREE 仅显示该包的层次结构。
